units.source_text: 名人清癯的脸颊和颈项显得更加瘦削了。

en.t: The master's gaunt cheeks and neck looked even thinner.

units.source_text: 比起酷热的七月十六日那天，愈发精神抖擞。

en.t: Compared with that sweltering day on July sixteenth, he seemed more vigorous than ever.

units.source_text: 也许可以说他掉了肉，骨头突出，反而显得意气风发。

en.t: One might say he had lost flesh and his bones stood out, yet this only made him look more spirited.
